options.label: A

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Chronicle must be in position 1." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Ballad → Epic
- Atlas → Diary → Chronicle → Epic → Ballad
- Atlas → Epic → Chronicle → Ballad → Diary
- Atlas → Epic → Chronicle → Diary → Ballad
- Diary → Atlas → Chronicle → Ballad → Epic
- Diary → Atlas → Chronicle → Epic → Ballad
- Epic → Atlas → Chronicle → Ballad → Diary
- Epic → Atlas → Chronicle → Diary → Ballad
